description: Public aggregate results, final figures and source code accompanying manuscript v15: Estimating Streamflow Across Major Chinese Rivers Using SWOT Satellite Data and Sparse Ground Observations. Includes QC, validation, error, product-comparison and numerical diagnostic summaries. Ground discharge time series, matched observation-level evaluation tables and related caches are excluded. Full numerical recalculation requires authorized external inputs. Public verification and table reconstruction use released aggregates only.
